newsitem.title: FRANCE: Elf says profit forecast unofficial.
newsitem.headline: Elf says profit forecast unofficial.

text.p: French energy group Elf Aquitaine said in a statement on Monday that a profit forecast published by Reuters was unofficial and could be misleading.
"On February 24, 1997...Reuters published a forecast of the 1996 financial results for the Elf Aquitaine Group citing 'a source close to the group'," Elf said.
Earlier on Monday, a source close to the company said Elf's 1996 operating profit should be more than 25 percent higher than the 1995 figures.

This rise from the 1995 figure of 15.5 billion francs is mainly due to the upstream activities which benefitted from the rise of the Brent crude oil price and the dollar, the source added, based on recent preliminary figures.
On December 19 the company estimated its 1996 net income before special items would be between 7.3 and 7.5 billion francs, the Elf statement said.
Elf said it will publish its definitive 1996 results on February 26, 1997.
